Information for Tenderer/Consultant :
Eligibility of Tenderer : (1) The minimum number of years of the general experience of the Tenderer in the construction works as Prime Contractor or
Subcontractor or Management Contractor shall be 15 years. [Years counting backward from the date of publication of IFT in the
newspaper], (2) (a) The minimum specific experience as a Prime Contractor or Subcontractor or Management Contractor in
construction works of at least 01 (one) contract(s) of similar nature, complexity and methods/construction technology successfully
completed within the last 05 (five) years, each with a value of at least Tk.600 crore. Similar nature, complexity, and
methods/construction technology mean construction of embankment cum road including regulator, (b) Construction of a minimum
3.00 km length of sheet pile RCC foundation retaining wall and minimum 2 km of walkway along sea/river banks in a contract.
[Years counting backward from the date of publication of IFT in the newspaper], (3) The required average annual construction
turnover shall be greater than Tk 685 crore over the last 05 (five) years. [Years counting backward from the date of publication of
IFT in the newspaper], (4) The minimum amount of liquid assets or working capital or credit facilities of the Tenderer shall be Tk
205 crore. (5) The minimum capacity shall be Taka 690 crore, (6) Tenderers Must have up-to-date valid Licenses as applicable, (7)
Other required eligibility and conditions of the tenderer are given in Tender Documents.
Brief Description of Works : Construction of 3.56 km of Road, 5776 meters of Retaining wall, 42800 sqm of embankment slope protection works, one no
Bridge, three nos Regulators, 15000 sqm Walkway, 1100000 meters PVD work, Bus Bay, Passenger shed with a toilet block, three
nos Foot over Bridge, 1400 meters Rigid Pavement, 3500 meters New Jersey Barrier, 18000 meters RCC Drain, and Connecting
Road, etc.
